name: B10-0053/2024 (ECR) – The severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
title: Resolution on the severe situation of political prisoners in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of all political prisoners in Belarus and says the Lukashenka regime must stop persecuting opponents, journalists, lawyers and national minorities. It asks for proper medical care for prisoners whose health is failing, an end to isolation that amounts to torture, and investigations into crimes by the regime. It also asks European Union countries to prepare court cases against Belarusian officials. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament demands the release of at least 1,347 political prisoners and medical care for the sick.
- It affects the Lukashenka regime, prisoners such as Andrzej Poczobut, and Belarusian officials who may face court cases.
- Next, the resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and member states; no legal change follows directly.
